description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Phantom is building the global trading app for mass adoption. We’re hiring a mid-level Copywriter in our Brand Innovation Group who can turn complex ideas into language people get instantly, while also shaping a brand voice that feels native to Gen-Z and the wider culture we’re trying to build.

You’ll split your time between innovative brand campaigns, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing. You’ll also bring ideas and projects to life that actually matter in culture: spotting what’s resonating on social (especially TikTok), reading taste, and turning those signals into work that extends Phantom beyond pure product messaging.

Responsibilities

Ideas, Culture and Social

  • Have a refined pulse on social media, especially TikTok, and the broader cultural currents that shape Gen-Z taste, humor, and attention.

  • Bring big-picture thinking to the table: identify cultural moments, trends, or community behaviors worth engaging with, and propose concrete ways Phantom can show up.

  • Develop, champion, and help deploy ideas and projects that build culture around the brand, not just promote features. This could include stunts, community campaigns, content series, or other formats that go beyond standard marketing.

Product Marketing

  • Write copy for social and website that supports launches and feature releases, with language that feels clear, specific, and culturally current.

  • Partner with product marketing managers to turn positioning into sharp, audience-native writing.

  • Draft in-app copy (feature announcements, empty states, onboarding moments) in close collaboration with design and product.

  • Help keep Phantom’s tone of voice consistent and distinctive across every surface, using brand guidelines as the foundation while pushing them forward where culture demands it.

Growth Marketing

  • Write lifecycle copy for email, push, and in-app messaging that moves people from signup through activation and ongoing engagement.

  • Write paid acquisition ad copy and generate variations for testing, with a feel for what actually resonates with Gen-Z and mass audiences.

  • Work with growth marketers on test hypotheses, then use results to decide what to scale, revise, or kill.

  • Adapt copy to audience segment, channel constraints, and market while keeping the brand’s cultural point of view intact.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years as a copywriter or in a similar creative role, with a portfolio that shows strong digital and brand writing and evidence of strategic or idea-led work that has cultural reach.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills: clarity, tone, voice, and the ability to make complex things feel simple and human.

  • Genuine fluency in Gen-Z language, platforms, and culture. You know what feels native versus what feels forced.

  • Comfort thinking in bigger ideas and turning them into executable projects, plus a track record of (or clear desire for) work that builds culture and reflects real taste, not just executing briefs or campaigns.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You can explain product value and also shape how people feel about the brand.

  • Experience collaborating across functions, including with technical or product teams, and influencing without formal authority.

  • Understanding of marketing principles, digital tactics, and how to use performance data to improve work


Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
